comment: DJFilter - the DJ mixer filter you ride by hand (Xone / DJM style). One DJ knob: -100 LP ... 0 ... +100 HP, -3..+3 flat (skipped). Exponential sweep (-100 about 40 Hz, +100 about 10 kHz), always 24 dB/oct, 3 ms smoothing. Resonance rises as the filter closes; Reso sets the far-end amount. Level trim, Mix = DJ crossfade. Footswitch on/off is ramped over a few ms. Linked stereo. The kick kill is its own effect: KickKill.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 492 Washout, 493 Breather, 494 Takeoff, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper, 501 Gooey, 502 DJFilter, 503 KickKill (this pack); probes 498-500. params.name: DJ
params.comment: One-knob DJ filter, shown -100 ... 0 ... +100 (value - 100). Left = low-pass, right = high-pass, -3..+3 flat. Exponential: -100 closes to about 40 Hz, +100 to about 10 kHz.

params.name: Reso
params.comment: Resonance at the far end of the sweep. None when the filter is open, rising as it closes, capped well below self-oscillation (Q about 5 at 100). Default 30.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Output trim in 0.5 dB steps: 0 = -12 dB, 24 = 0 dB, 36 = +6 dB. Default 0 dB.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50. Default 100.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate, not measured. The DJFilter with Kill, Slope and Glide was estimated at about 2,485 cycles (46). This one drops the Kill path and its tests, the Slope branch and the Glide maths, inlines the one filter pair (no call) and has a smaller state seal: about 2,400 cycles (the compiled code is 13 % smaller). 2,400 / 75 + 25 % = 40, +4 seal = 44. Declared = cycles / 75 + 25 %, rounded up (docs/STEREO.md); 1% LOAD = 544 cycles. Re-measure on the pedal (SYSTEM > LOAD).
